articles.title: Legislative Update: Education Funding
articles.author: Rachelle Bassen, Union President
articles.excerpt: Advocating for more funding from the legislature.
articles.content: The Nevada Legislature is currently reviewing the higher education budget. Your NFA team is monitoring several key bills that would impact faculty working conditions and compensation. We encourage all members to stay informed and participate in upcoming advocacy days at the legislature.

articles.title: State Employee Benefits Premiums Set to rise!
articles.author: Rachelle Bassen, Union President
articles.excerpt: Negotiating with the state to address the rising costs of employee benefits.
articles.content: The Union is actively negotiating with the state to address the rising costs of employee benefits. We are committed to ensuring that our members receive fair and affordable healthcare coverage. Stay tuned for updates on the progress of these negotiations and how they may impact your benefits. Join the next union meeting to learn more about how you can get involved and support our efforts to secure better benefits for all state employees.

articles.title: Bargaining Session Updates Summary - Week 4
articles.author: WNC-NFA Lead Negotiator
articles.excerpt: Progress made on wage increases and workplace safety provisions.
articles.content: NFA is advocating for a 5% cost-of-living-increase for the next two years. This ensures that our members will receive sufficient salary ahead of the rising inflation likely to continue for at least another year.

articles.title: Another header
articles.author: WNC-NFA Lead Negotiator
articles.excerpt: WNC stalls negotiations on critical proposals.
articles.content: WNC has not provided a counter to our article on Union rights. We have been waiting for over a month. As a result, we are not willing to negotiate on some of their asks until we see that proposal.
